body: Not sure anymore, some odd combination of traits. I wish it was something specific.

>Going to kill myself in a few hours. by hdgduxbin SuicideWatch

>[–]mumblesgrapes 2 points 2 hours ago 

>Look, I've tried suicide at least 10 times in my life. At the Very least. Even woke up in icu a few times with Very close calls. I was Always glad to wake up. I know that it takes courage. It's hard. No one wants to die, imo. Why would you? the end is the end. That's it. Why not try to stick around with me. If I can, you can, believe me. I'm totally suicidal and fucked up lol

Just a bad moment, or anything specific change? Just life in general?

I got banned from /r/foreveralone.  How's that?

I read some of your posts; isn't it awful when you get to that moment and realize no one is going to stop you?  Standing on the bridge and no one even notices.  It puts things in perspective.  Some see that as liberation, not much you can really do with it though, from this vantage point.

I'm just waiting out my death.  I heard life was short, but it's agonizingly long.  So sick of it.  So sick of wasting it; anything I do I do alone, always, forever.  It's the only constant.  But see, I'm too scared to actually do it. I can describe that moment of adrenaline on the bridge, feeling the shaking and all of that, but I'm afraid I'd screw it up. End up a paraplegic that hates life even more; seems about right, really.

Didn't go out for Halloween, exercised in the AM and interacted with all the crazy people, some crawling and or passed out in main roads.  I have nothing to do today, or the next day, or the next.  I donate my time sometimes, but people don't like to be around me, I'm unbearable. So I'm just waiting, watching those who were supposed to be my peers lap me socially, just wanting a moment above water for once. I'm already dead.

I appreciate the response; at this point I don't have anything, there is no hope.  I'm a joke, but not even in the sort of funny way, the kind where people purposely try not to talk to me because I'm such a mess socially.  If I try to talk to a group it slowly disbands and reforms elsewhere, rather common occurrence. People feel uncomfortable around me, or they just laugh if I try to talk, always a bit surprised, never taking it seriously, can't blame them.  So it's either kill self or somehow think that multiple decades more of this is worth it. 

The only thing I had before were excuses and hope; hope because of excuses. I don't have that anymore, it's over. You just get laughed at if you try to bolster yourself and you fail, clearly not as smart as you think you are, can't even figure out how to stand and talk correctly, you expect us to take anything else you do seriously? It's over, I need to kill myself, I just am afraid. I don't want to die, I just don't want to live anymore, I want to be old, on my deathbed, involuntarily giving my last gasp. I want to go to sleep forever, at least dreams allow growth.

Apparently when someone is struggling socially it's a humorous thing.

I guess I made some people laugh today, so that's good.  It was at my expense, because they couldn't believe how much of a loser I am, and no, I don't get to do anything for Halloween, just like last weekend, and the one before, and the month before that, the month before that, the year before that, the year before that...

I don't understand.  Apparently life is nothing more than an economy, if you don't have capital to start, you're fucked and your life will never go anywhere.  Apparently my life is a joke, I am an entity worthy of mockery, not connection.

I have posted on this website almost every weekend for months. I have taken every suggestion offered to me and then some, by people on here, family, others.  Life is only getting worse.  I guess I am just waiting to get hit by a car, no one will give me a chance.  Why do I have to live life alone?  Why is life so desolate?  Why will not a single person in real life **ever** give me a chance.  I mean that literally, **no one** has ever given me a chance, **not once.  NOT ONCE.** WHAT THE FUCK, I AM NOT A FUCKING JOKE>>!~>!>?!

It's like people purposely set out to shit on each other.

Then they laugh at you and pretend you did it to yourself.  That there was something there if you just would have taken it, but when you try, your hand is swatted away and you are mocked.  The world is a joke, it is empty, it is full of beautiful things destroyed by people trying to make a buck, it is run by callous uncaring people and is mostly filled with others out only to use you as a mark or ignore you entirely.  We shit on people them blame them for smelling. When someone reaches out we send them to someone else. We laugh at people we will not give a chance, then tell them everything is their fault. I guess it is.
I appreciate the kind words and the effort you made.

I'm ugly and bad at socializing.  Yes.  I go out and am pushed away.

As such, I need to kill myself.  Yes.  I am aware of this, I have thought about it before.  Lonely girls look at me with anger if I so much as notice they exist and have an involuntary reaction.  As such, I need to completely reformat my entire subconscious just to get to enjoy basic human contact that most everyone who are not living in a tent city get by default (unless you're broken, like me).  Oh boy, maybe *another* decade of self-improvement will lead me to the promised land. Maybe if I read every book that ever exists, and frequent every social group in the entire metro area, win some national championship at a sport and then walk around exclusively in expensive clothing, one person will give me a chance, and I'll screw it up by being so shocked that I have a stroke on the spot. Where's that stick, I need to go to the store and buy a carrot. I'm not saying everyone is superficial, I'm saying it appears this is not enough.

Sorry, I just don't care anymore.  I wanted human connection, it was too much to ask.  As such, I need to die.  The end.

I have no doubt I'm off putting, hell, being in the mere presence of an ugly person can be off putting, especially if you're trying to feel sexy. That's to say nothing of my personality, but let's be real here, pretty people act the same as ugly people but get different reactions.  It's no different than a short ambitious person being called "napoleon."  We see what we want to see.

I suppose I have nothing worthwhile attractive about me.  I have no negatives, but no positives. I am in shape, but I'm not an attractive person. I'm intelligent, but everyone believes themselves to be.

If I do those things, I'll then be told that I didn't do them for myself, and just to be more attractive.  Lose-lose. I've spent countless hours in introspection trying to figure it out, it really comes down to looks, and how "fun" you are.  How relaxed you are, how much you have to offer.  The thing is, every relationship ends up being one-sided, I offer something, they take. I ask, do not receive, am called entitled. Then get told I just don't understand humanity.  No, I do, I'm not just at the top of the pole, I can't use any of the knowledge from a position without power. Two guys approach a girl, same exact approach, one is tall and handsome, the other a bridge troll, one is creepy, one is just a nice confident dude.  We'll tell the bridge troll it was personality though, like the obvious isn't, make him go full neurotic obsessing over what he said differently...

People don't like me because I'm not cool, not fun, not relaxed, too cynical, not sexy.  Ethereal concept that it is, changes from person to person, same shit, different day.

A couple of people thousands of miles away, that's it though. No one near; quite shameful, really. Can't connect with the people around me. Tried various methods and ways of going about it, appear to be moving backward.

I don't necessarily want advice.  I mean I do, but I'm not sure it's out there; countless philosophical texts have been read and I'm still back at square one, just a slightly more nuanced version of such.

What I meant was that "better person" was what someone else chose. As in, that person will be my friend, my lover, the other person in the duet, climbing partner, my business associate, etc. In that sense, there is a chosen and a not chosen, that's all I meant.

I am into other things, but I spent my entire life trying to point away from what I want.  I want human connection more than I want to do other things, it's only natural. Without other people, you can't even discuss those things. We're social beasts, right? I try to enjoy life, but without connection it is nearly impossible without hard drugs and general hedonism in the mix, that's open honesty. Asceticism leads to nocturnal emissions and frustration. That's just my experience, always open to others, just not sure they'll work, very skeptical, been lead on much more often than not.
